build_distributed_mcts_topology: build a distributed MCTS agent topology with replay, learner, actor, and evaluator nodes using Launchpad
create_replay_storage: create a Reverb replay table with uniform sampling and FIFO removal for MCTS transition storage
create_learner: create an AZLearner with an Adam optimizer that learns from a Reverb dataset
create_mcts_actor: create an MCTS actor with N-step transitions, variable syncing, and a configurable number of simulations
create_evaluator: create an evaluation loop with an MCTS actor and default logger for periodic policy assessment
